---
description: "Use when creating or editing README files. Prevents unnecessary hard wrapping of prose paragraphs."
applyTo: "**/README.md"
---

# README Prose Formatting

- Keep each prose paragraph on one logical line. Do not insert hard line breaks merely to satisfy a column-width limit; let the editor wrap long lines visually.
- Add line breaks only when they carry structure or meaning, such as between paragraphs, headings, list items, blockquotes, table rows, or lines in code blocks.
- Preserve an existing intentional wrapping style when required by a formatter or file format, and do not reflow unrelated text while making a focused edit.
